source_wording: Paraphrase: the army marched through the Bear Tavern (S21).
notes: Traced along today's Washington Crossing-Pennington Road and Bear Tavern Road.

source_wording: Paraphrase: the army marched through the Bear Tavern and Birmingham (S21).
notes: Traced along today's Bear Tavern Road.

source_wording: Paraphrase: Greene's wing turned left at Birmingham onto Upper Ferry Road, which becomes Parkway Avenue, and right onto Pennington Road (S63); it took a short road from Birmingham to the Scotch Road (S22) and joined the Pennington road about a mile beyond the village (S21).
notes: Traced along today's Upper Ferry Road and Parkway Avenue (OpenStreetMap, 18 Nov 2026) to Pennington Road, as the driving tour gives it (S63). Parkway Avenue passes the south end of today's Scotch Road, so it also fits the Scotch Road accounts. Replaces a straight guess and a loop up Scotch Road.

source_wording: Paraphrase: Sullivan's wing took the River road (S21).
notes: Traced along today's Sullivan Way and West State Street.

source_wording: Paraphrase: Greene's division forced the upper picket (S21).
Paraphrase: Greene's division, with Washington in the lead, occupied the high ground at the head of the town after skirmishing on the Pennington Road (S23).
Paraphrase: Sullivan's men pushed the Hermitage outpost back toward town and took the southern part of it (S22).
notes: Which streets the column used inside the town is not stated.

source_wording: Paraphrase: Rall and von Lossberg fell back out of the town (S22).
Paraphrase: after Rall fell the troops retreated to the apple orchard at the eastern edge of the village (S22).
Paraphrase: those not killed or taken fled down the road toward Bordentown (S20).
notes: Ends at the bridge; the road to Bordentown is off the map.

source_wording: Paraphrase: over the Assunpink bridge and away to Princeton (S59; S61).
notes: The road is not recorded: drawn over the bridge, round the east of the town and up the Quaker Bridge road, keeping clear of the American column on the Princeton road.

source_wording: Paraphrase: they fled down the road toward Bordentown (S20).
notes: Drawn along the road down the Delaware by Lamberton and White Horse; the exact road is not recorded.

source_wording: Paraphrase: they made for the Crosswicks drawbridge (S61).
notes: Drawn straight across country to Crosswicks; the road is not recorded.
